size_rationale: Small because it is a one-line fix in the login endpoint's own service function, which the prompt points at by naming POST /v1/auth/login and the 'Incorrect email or password' check it should fail.
prompt: POST /v1/auth/login returns 200 and tokens for an existing email even when the password is wrong; it should return 401 'Incorrect email or password'.

root_cause.detail: Missing await: `!user.isPasswordMatch(password)` negates a pending Promise (always truthy), so the password check never fails and any password logs in.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/login > should return 401 error if password is wrong
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/auth.test.js -t 'should return 401 error if password is wrong'
